storyboardBeats.narration: Most car noises can wait. These three cannot.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Interior POV from the driver's seat, hands resting on the steering wheel, dashboard instrument cluster softly glowing, dusk light through the windshield, faint tension in the framing, slow subtle handheld sway, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Grinding when you brake. Knocking that speeds up with the engine.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro of a brake caliper gripping a rotor mid-rotation, dim garage bay lighting, slow push-in, shallow depth of field, texture-forward metal surfaces, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A rhythmic clunk that tracks with your wheel speed — not your engine speed.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a front suspension strut and control-arm assembly on a shop lift, slow lateral dolly tracking along the assembly toward the wheel hub, even workshop practical lighting, mechanical texture-forward, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Every one of these gets dramatically more expensive with every mile you keep driving.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Close-up push-in on a damaged metal part resting on a shop workbench under harsh inspection light, slow pull-back revealing two more visibly worn parts scattered nearby to imply cascading damage, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Send this to someone who just said their car's making a weird noise. Nick's Tire and Auto — link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
